scope: T-prefixed Ford truck part references with source-specific classification; not vehicle VINs and not automatically FINIS codes.
important_notes: T references are only extracted from the actual product OEM field. Internal supplier IDs are separate; no T number is derived from a filename or product ID.
Ford/Cargo/F-MAX model acceptance uses the actual Suitable For product row, not global headers or promotional boilerplate. T SERIES alone is not accepted as Ford.
Each reference group is documented on one source product. Multiple T and engineering references are not cross-joined into invented one-to-one equivalents.

No Ford EPC or official Ford documentation established that all these are FINIS/service numbers or European-only. Site labels should say T reference / Ford OEM reference according to the cited catalogue.
Manufacturer catalogue claims still require VIN, engine, build-year and part-version confirmation before supply.
Vaden public sitemap access was blocked by Cloudflare; only accessible indexed product pages were used. No protection was bypassed.

records.mapping_relationship: Orex own product catalogue explicitly labels all these references FORD under OEM and names Ford FMAX/Cargo in the product title. Specific model years/engines are not supplied.
